## Merging and data scaling
```{r} 
Combined_hpa <- merge(obj_0_hpa_B_original, y = c(obj_1_hpa_B_original, obj_3_hpa_A_original, obj_12_hpa_A_original), project = "Combined_hpa")
all.genes <- rownames(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- NormalizeData(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- FindVariableFeatures(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- ScaleData(Combined_hpa, features = all.genes)


```


## PCA UMAP
```{r PCA}
Combined_hpa <- RunPCA(Combined_hpa)
ElbowPlot(Combined_hpa, ndims = 50)
Combined_hpa <- FindNeighbors(Combined_hpa, dims = 1:30 , reduction = "pca")
Combined_hpa <- FindClusters(Combined_hpa, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
Combined_hpa <- RunUMAP(Combined_hpa, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
DimPlot(Combined_hpa, reduction = "umap.unintegrated" )
```
